limitations: No checkpoint tensor download or independent rehash; checkpoint digest equality verifies exported bindings only.
Input provenance describes latest recorded inputs, not every historical transition.
Same-frame peak contributions identify reward arithmetic, not why policy/actions/state reached that frame.
Finite_fraction and push exposure are runtime exports, not independently reconstructed full trajectories.
Training retains frozen velocity-increment perturbations; external-force protocol, no displacement gate and repeated 80%/.22s are evaluation conditions audited separately.
Partial snapshot does not claim missing dev/accept/sealed jobs completed or generation accepted.
